name: 45432 · Beavercreek, OH
findings: ZIP 45432 (Beavercreek) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45432 (Beavercreek) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45432 (Beavercreek) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
